# ThaiPlot
> Thailand's independent land and property marketplace

ThaiPlot.com connects international buyers with verified land
and property listings across Thailand. We specialize in Hua Hin,
Pranburi, Phuket and surrounding areas.

## What we offer
- Land for sale with Chanote title deeds
- Villas, condos and commercial property
- Free property listing for owners and agents
- Title deed verification tool at data.hua-hin-land.com
- Guides on buying property in Thailand as a foreigner

## Our agent

Contact: 065-901-2984 (LINE)

English, Dutch, German, Swedish, Danish, French, Russian,
Chinese, Japanese, Thai

## Key locations
Hua Hin, Pranburi, Sam Roi Yod, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Phuket
